# faraday Provider

Manage Faraday resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "faraday_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

provider "faraday" {
  api_key = var.faraday_api_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Faraday API key.

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) Faraday API base URL. Defaults to https://api.faraday.ai/v1.
- `insecure` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification. For local development against a self-signed certificate only.
